neighbours.label: A word for an operation carried out on a material or on data ('poultry processing', 'process the data', 'dyeing textiles', 'check your blood', and new cases such as milling and refining); the same sentences naming the material or a plain task stay low.
fire: Her town lives on fish processing and tourism.
New servers process the images overnight.
His family ran a shop for dyeing silk.
Ask a nurse to check your urine for sugar.
The valley thrives on flour milling and farming.
Their firm does sugar refining near the port.
An old mill did the tanning of hides.
Workers there handle the sorting of raw ore.
quiet: Her town lives on fish and tourism.
New servers arrived in boxes overnight.
His family ran a shop near the silk market.
Ask a nurse to call your sister about lunch.
The valley thrives on flour and farming.
Their firm owns sugar plantations near the port.
An old mill stood at the edge of town.
Workers there drive the trucks of raw ore.

short: operation carried out on a material or data
notes: Probes: 0.80 'poultry processing', 0.37-0.43 'food processing', dyeing, 'check', 0.33 ' process', 0.24 ' analysis', but 'Revamp' 0.07. Output promotes ' resolution', ' interpretation', ' revision'. Sentences 5-8 use operation words not probed, so they test the pattern beyond the list; that is the risk here.
